abstract_labels_flagged_not_excluded.why_not_excluded: an abstract noun in the devata slot is NOT automatically contamination. Sraddha, Manyu and Vac are abstractions and are genuine Vedic deities; abhisapa ('the curse') and adhyetrstuti ('praise of the reciter') are not. The distinction is a curation judgement and this agent does not make it silently. The list is handed to Agent 15 with each node's own curation_note.

A deliberate refusal. The Brahmanas answer the question by identifying Ka with Prajapati, and it would be easy to import that answer here, but it is post-Rigvedic exegesis and asserting it would dress a later reading as a textual fact. The label is left as what it is, an interrogative in the deity slot, with no axis.

Structure is ABSTRACT because the label is the common noun for wrath, but the Atharvavedic hymns address him as an armed ally who goes before the fighter, which is the basis for WARRIOR alongside ABSTRACT_PERSONIFICATION. CHTHONIC and PSYCHOPOMP were both considered and refused. Mrtyu is addressed as a power to be turned aside, not as a ruler of an underworld and not as a guide of the dead, and giving him either axis would import a later infernal picture that these verses do not have.

Her name is the abstraction of undoing, which ABSTRACT_PERSONIFICATION records. CHTHONIC records her association with the nether region, which is stated in the later Vedic prose more firmly than in the Rigveda, so confidence is MEDIUM.

The verses themselves, not a deity of speech. SPEECH is reserved for deities whose domain is speech, so no axis is asserted, consistently with the svaha calls and the Hotr's benedictions.

HEALER was seriously considered here, since the whole content of the label is the removal of disease. It is refused for consistency with the other charm-purpose labels: the slot names the intended act, not an agent who possesses a healing power, and the healers proper in this file are Rudra, the Asvins, the plants and the Waters. A reviewer who disagrees should change all the charm labels together, not this one alone.

One of only two entries in this file with an UNSPECIFIED structure, and the reason is grammatical rather than religious: sunah is ambiguous between the genitive singular and the nominative plural of svan, so the label does not settle number and neither INDIVIDUAL nor GROUP can be read off it. A deified animal in either case, so no axis is asserted.
